title: 집들이에 가서: 뭘 이런 걸 다 사 왔어요?
objective: Give and accept a gift politely, compliment a new home, and use -어 놓다.
summary: A guest visits a friend's new home for a housewarming and gives a gift.
setting: Saturday evening at Jisu's new apartment. Her coworker Mark arrives first for the housewarming party.

task.title: Practice housewarming talk
task.line: Read each item and write your answer using the expressions and -어 놓다 from this worksheet.

words.meaning: do something ahead of time so the result stays ready (action verbs only; 놓았어요 → 놨어요 in speech)
words.exampleMeaning: I put some water in the fridge for us to drink.

words.meaning: it's nothing much, but (a modest thing to say when giving a gift)
words.example: 별거 아니지만 제가 직접 만든 쿠키예요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's nothing much, but I made these cookies myself.

words.meaning: you shouldn't have (a polite reply when you receive a gift)
words.example: 뭘 이런 걸 다 가져왔어요? 그냥 오셔도 되는데.
words.exampleMeaning: You shouldn't have brought anything. You could have just come.
Last month I moved closer to my office.
Take your time and relax before you go.

words.meaning: to look around (someone's home); 구경 is the noun, as in 구경해요
words.exampleMeaning: May I see the kitchen too?

dialogue.korean: 집들이 축하해요! 이거 별거 아니지만 받으세요.
dialogue.meaning: Congratulations on your housewarming! It's nothing much, but please take this.

dialogue.korean: 와, 휴지네요! 뭘 이런 걸 다 사 왔어요? 어서 들어오세요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, toilet paper! You really shouldn't have bought this and brought it. Come on in.

dialogue.korean: 집이 정말 넓고 깨끗하네요. 언제 이렇게 정리했어요?
dialogue.meaning: Your place is really big and clean. When did you get it all organized?

dialogue.korean: 어제 하루 종일 청소해 놨어요. 신발은 여기 두세요.
dialogue.meaning: I cleaned it all day yesterday so it would be ready. You can leave your shoes here.

dialogue.korean: 네. 그럼 집 구경 좀 해도 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay. Then can I look around the place?

dialogue.korean: 그럼요. 방은 이쪽이에요. 음식도 미리 만들어 놨으니까 많이 드세요.
dialogue.meaning: Of course. The rooms are this way. I made the food ahead of time, so please eat plenty.

exercises: Fill in the blank using 사다 + -어 놓다 in the past tense: 손님들이 마실 맥주를 미리 ____.
A guest says '집이 정말 깨끗하네요.' Choose the host's natural reply: (a) 어제 청소해 놨어요. (b) 어제 청소해 놓고 싶어요.
Change the verb in brackets to -어 놓아서 form: 에어컨을 (켜다) ____ 거실이 시원해요.
Is -어 놓다 used naturally? Write Yes or No: ① 어제 케이크를 사 놨어요. 그래서 오늘은 안 사도 돼요. ② 어제 머리가 아파 놨어요. ③ 문을 열어 놨으니까 그냥 들어오세요. ④ 이 방은 넓어 놨어요.
Fill in the blank with one word: 구경, 편하게, 이사 — ① 다음 달에 학교 근처로 ____해요. ② 소파에 ____ 앉으세요. ③ 거실도 ____해도 돼요?
answers: ① Yes ② No ③ Yes ④ No
① 이사 ② 편하게 ③ 구경
